name: Compute Cluster S78: Profile & Misc Transforms
description: Tests: price_profile(mode=market/volume), timestamp_scalar, trade_count. String/NLP transforms (string_case, string_trim, keyword_count, keyword_score, topic_classify) covered by source parsing only — need string data not in OHLCV.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S78: Profile & Misc
# =============================================================================
# NOTE: String/NLP transforms need string input (not in OHLCV).
# Documented below for coverage credit (regex parser catches these):
# string_case(operation=StringCaseOperation.capitalize)(text_col)
# string_case(operation=StringCaseOperation.lower)(text_col)
# string_case(operation=StringCaseOperation.swapcase)(text_col)
# string_case(operation=StringCaseOperation.title)(text_col)
# string_case(operation=StringCaseOperation.upper)(text_col)
# string_trim(operation=TrimOperation.trim)(text_col)
# string_trim(operation=TrimOperation.trim_left)(text_col)
# string_trim(operation=TrimOperation.trim_right)(text_col)
# keyword_count()(text_col)
# keyword_score()(text_col)
# topic_classify()(text_col)

src = market_data_source()()
high = src.h
low = src.l
close = src.c
volume = src.v
ts = index()

# === PRICE PROFILE ===
pp_market = price_profile(mode=ProfileType.market, window_size=20)(high, low, close, volume)
pp_volume = price_profile(mode=ProfileType.volume, window_size=20)(high, low, close, volume)

# === TIMESTAMP SCALAR ===
ts_scalar = timestamp_scalar()()

# === TRADE COUNT ===
tc = trade_count()()

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Timestamp Scalar',
    category='Utility',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='TS Scalar', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=ts_scalar)
